text:
Customer - Acme Corp: Hey team—since the rollout yesterday our app is getting wrong tool calls from the model. Previously the assistant would call the weather API with args like {"city": "Seattle"}, now it either doesn't call the tool at all, or calls it with an empty payload. This started right after 2026-02-28 22:10 UTC when you flipped the new runtime.
Alex Chen: sorry to hear that. Can you paste a minimal failing request/response?
Customer - Acme Corp: sure. here's the curl we use (simplified):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
 -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..."
 -H "Content-Type: application/json"
 -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-2026-2","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"What's the weather in Seattle?"}],"functions":[{"name":"get_weather","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"city":{"type":"string"}}}}],"function_call":"auto"}'
```
Customer - Acme Corp: Expected: a function call to get_weather with {"city":"Seattle"}. Actual: model returns assistant text suggesting to check a website, no function_call field, and later when it does call the function the args are {}.
Maria Gonzalez: thanks — did you pin any model version or is that model name the one you rely on? Also, can you share the request_id from the response headers (x-request-id)?
Customer - Acme Corp: not pinned, using model redwood-chat-2026-2. x-request-id: req_0a9f3b2c. I can repro consistently from our staging cluster. Latency is slightly higher too ~600ms vs ~200ms previously.
Alex Chen: copying SRE and ML eng. @Oncall SRE @ML Eng - Priya — looks like the new rollout changed behavior for function/tool calling for some prompts. Priya, do we have any model variant changes or tokenizer updates that might affect function detection?
ML Eng - Priya: AFAIK we rolled out a small safety-layer change that filters low-confidence function calls to reduce accidental invocations; it was gated behind a soft threshold. That could explain missed calls. BUT it shouldn't zero-out args. Empty args sounds like an RK/VALUE serialization bug in the runtime when function_call gets proxied to the tool adapter.
Ian (DevX): adding logs from the proxy for req_0a9f3b2c — snippet: 
```
[proxy] 2026-02-28T22:10:01Z req_0a9f3b2c model=redwood-chat-2026-2 routing=variant-b function_decision=SUPPRESS confidence=0.41
[runtime] 2026-02-28T22:10:01Z req_0a9f3b2c fn_call=get_weather args_serialized="{}"
[tool-adapter] 2026-02-28T22:10:01Z req_0a9f3b2c dispatched=true payload={}
```
Oncall SRE: interesting — function_decision=SUPPRESS and yet runtime logged a fn_call with args_serialized="{}". That indicates the safety-layer suppressed the call, but the adapter still got an empty payload. Possibly a race between suppression flag and adapter wiring.
Maria Gonzalez: Customer, thanks for the repro. For a quick workaround can you set "function_call":"none" and call the function client-side from your app when you see an intent? Alternatively pin to redwood-chat-2025-12 (previous stable) — we'll confirm if the stable behaves correctly.
Customer - Acme Corp: We can't reliably detect intent client-side without repeating LLM costs; we relied on the model to call for us. Pinning is possible but disruptive. Is there a timeline for fix? This is affecting billing too since we get charged for additional retries.
Alex Chen: Understood. Priya, any ETA on a patch? Also, can we confirm whether the safety threshold change was rolled to 100%? I thought it was canaryed.
ML Eng - Priya: It was intended as 10% canary but rollout automation mistakenly applied it to 100% for the chat-2026 family in eu-west-1 between 22:08-22:09 UTC. Root cause: a terraform variable override during the deployment. I'm creating a revert now.
Ian (DevX): I'm attaching a quick repro harness script for internal use to reproduce the empty-args case locally: 
```python
import requests
url='https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat'
headers={'Authorization':'Bearer sk-test','Content-Type':'application/json'}
payload={
  'model':'redwood-chat-2026-2',
  'messages':[{'role':'user','content':'Call get_weather for Seattle'}],
  'functions':[{'name':'get_weather','parameters':{'type':'object','properties':{'city':{'type':'string'}}}}],
  'function_call':'auto'
}
r=requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
print(r.headers.get('x-request-id'), r.text)
```
Support Bot: Ticket created #SUP-12345. Notifying account team.
Alex Chen: Action items so far: 1) rollback safety filter to previous state (Priya) 2) investigate why adapter got {} even when suppressed (Ian + Oncall SRE) 3) provide customer-facing mitigation steps & ETA (Maria) 4) optionally offer billing credit (Support).
Oncall SRE: I found related logs showing an adapter code path that constructs payload from the last known kv-cache entry rather than from the fresh parsed function args when suppression flag is set. That explains {} payloads. Patch candidate: ensure adapter reads canonical fn_args from runtime output even if suppression flagged. I'll open a PR.
ML Eng - Priya: Rolling back now for eu-west-1. I triggered rollback at 22:34 UTC, monitoring.
Customer - Acme Corp: thanks — after you rolled back I see function calls returning again with correct args. x-request-id for successful call: req_0a9f3c00. Latency back to ~210ms.
Maria Gonzalez: closing the loop — we've applied a rollback and a hotfix to the adapter to avoid empty args when suppression is toggled. We'll follow up with a permanent deployment fix (ensure canary config doesn't get entirely applied). We're also opening an internal postmortem and will share it with your CSM.
Customer - Acme Corp: appreciate the quick response. Please confirm billing credit and whether this will be on the account automatically or if we need to file a separate request.
Support Bot: Billing ticket #BILL-678 opened, assigned to Maria.
Maria Gonzalez: We'll review usage during the incident window and propose a credit. I'll follow up in-thread with the CSM and finance.
Alex Chen: tagging for follow-ups: @ML Eng - Priya to produce root cause writeup, @Oncall SRE to add adapter unit tests, @Ian (DevX) to add repro harness to run in CI against rollout canaries, @Support Bot to coordinate billing flow.
ML Eng - Priya: I'll post a short summary and RCA in #eng-releases once written.
Customer - Acme Corp: leaving a note — when you post the RCA please include the exact rollout id so we can correlate to our logs. Thanks again. :thumbsup:
